ns0:parameter.ns0:name: CFPCOLS
ns0:parameter.ns0:comment: The columns of the crowded-field photometry file that contain: ID, x position, y position and magnitude of the stars
ns0:parameter.ns0:updated: Appended parameter CFPCOLS to configuration file.
Disabled usage of parameter.

ns0:parameter.ns0:name: PASSBAND
ns0:parameter.ns0:comment: The photometric passband in which the provided magnitudes are given
ns0:parameter.ns0:updated: Appended parameter PASSBAND to configuration file.

ns0:parameter.ns0:name: ZEROMAG
ns0:parameter.ns0:comment: The magnitude zeropoint of the IFS data in the provided passband, i.e. the magnitude of a source triggering 1 count/layer. Set this parameter to 99.9 to let the routine determine the zeropoint from the data.
ns0:parameter.ns0:updated: Appended parameter ZEROMAG to configuration file.

ns0:parameter.ns0:name: PIXSCALE
ns0:parameter.ns0:comment: The spaxel scale if the observation. Note that this parameter is used only if PampelMuse can not determine the spaxel scale from the FITS header of the data.
ns0:parameter.ns0:updated: Appended parameter PIXSCALE to configuration file.

ns0:parameter.ns0:name: APERRAD
ns0:parameter.ns0:comment: Radius (in spaxels) used for aperture spectrophotometry
Note that this parameter only has an effect if the SMALLIFU flag is unset.
ns0:parameter.ns0:updated: Appended parameter APERRAD to configuration file.

ns0:parameter.ns0:name: APERNOIS
ns0:parameter.ns0:comment: The maximum allowed fraction of contaminating flux within APERRAD. Aperture spectrophotometry is performed only for sources whose nearby neighbors contribute less than APERNOIS to the measured flux.
ns0:parameter.ns0:updated: Appended parameter APERNOIS to configuration file.

ns0:parameter.ns0:name: RESLIM
ns0:parameter.ns0:comment: The magnitude down to which stars can possibly be resolved in the datacube.
ns0:parameter.ns0:updated: Appended parameter RESLIM to configuration file.

ns0:parameter.ns0:name: UPDATERL
ns0:parameter.ns0:comment: If UPDATERL-flag is set, PampelMuse will determine the confusion limit and update RESLIM accordingly.
ns0:parameter.ns0:updated: Appended parameter UPDATERL to configuration file.

ns0:parameter.ns0:name: CONFDENS
ns0:parameter.ns0:comment: The confusion limit, i.e the number of stars per resultion element. A resolution element is defined as the FWHM \[pixel\] of the PSF squared. Only used if UPDATERL-flag is set.
ns0:parameter.ns0:updated: Appended parameter CONFDENS to configuration file.

ns0:parameter.ns0:name: SNRCUT
ns0:parameter.ns0:comment: The cut in expected Signal-to-Noise below which no sources are selected. The Signal-to-Noise is determined from the estimated FWHM and the results of the aperture spectrophotometry .
ns0:parameter.ns0:updated: Appended parameter SNRCUT to configuration file.

ns0:parameter.ns0:name: BINRAD
ns0:parameter.ns0:comment: The minimum spatial separation [measured in units of the expected FWHM] of two resolved sources. Resolved sources with distances smaller BINRAD are combined.
ns0:parameter.ns0:updated: Appended parameter BINRAD to configuration file.

ns0:parameter.ns0:name: GLOBSKY
ns0:parameter.ns0:comment: Flag indicating if additional components should be included to account for an unresollved background or the sky. The behaviour of these components can be controlled with the SKYSIZE parameter.
ns0:parameter.ns0:updated: Appended parameter GLOBSKY to configuration file.

ns0:parameter.ns0:name: SKYSIZE
ns0:parameter.ns0:comment: The distance between two adjacent points in the grid used to model an unresolved background or the night sky. If set to a negative value only a constant background/sky componnent is used. Only has an effect if GLOBSKY is True.
ns0:parameter.ns0:updated: Appended parameter SKYSIZE to configuration file.

ns0:parameter.ns0:name: USEUNRES
ns0:parameter.ns0:comment: Flag indicates whether the contribution from the unresolved sources should be included as an additional component in the analysis.
ns0:parameter.ns0:updated: Appended parameter USEUNRES to configuration file.

ns0:parameter.ns0:name: UNRESBIN
ns0:parameter.ns0:comment: Only has an effect if USEUNRES is enabled. In that case the contribution of the sources in the magnitude interval of width UNRESBIN below the confusion limit is combined in an unresolved stellar component
ns0:parameter.ns0:updated: Appended parameter UNRESBIN to configuration file.

ns0:parameter.ns0:name: SMALLIFU
ns0:parameter.ns0:comment: This flag defines how the determination of the PSF and the coordinate transformation is performed during the fit. If SMALLIFU is enabled, all sources are used for this purpose (recommended for IFUs with a small number of spatial pixels), otherwise bright, isolated stars are used (recommended for MUSE)
ns0:parameter.ns0:updated: Appended parameter SMALLIFU to configuration file.

ns0:parameter.ns0:name: USESIGMA
ns0:parameter.ns0:comment: A flag indicating if the uncertainties of the IFS data should be used in the extraction.
ns0:parameter.ns0:updated: Appended parameter USESIGMA to configuration file.

ns0:parameter.ns0:name: LAYERRNG
ns0:parameter.ns0:comment: The spectral range of the datacube that should be analysed, given as the indices of the first and the last layer in that range. By default, the whole cube is analysed.
ns0:parameter.ns0:updated: Appended parameter LAYERRNG to configuration file.

ns0:parameter.ns0:name: LAYERBIN
ns0:parameter.ns0:comment: The spectral binning factor of the IFS data during the analysis.
ns0:parameter.ns0:updated: Appended parameter LAYERBIN to configuration file.

ns0:parameter.ns0:name: PSFRAD
ns0:parameter.ns0:comment: The radius out to which the PSF of a source will be defined. Should be large enough to avoid annuli of flux around the brighter sources in the residuals
ns0:parameter.ns0:updated: Appended parameter PSFRAD to configuration file.

ns0:parameter.ns0:name: POSFIT
ns0:parameter.ns0:comment: Defines how source positions are handled in the fit:
0 - Sources are fixed to their input positions.
1 - Only a global offset is fitted.
2 - A global offset and scaling are fitted.
3 - Individual positions are fitted.
ns0:parameter.ns0:updated: Appended parameter POSFIT to configuration file.

ns0:parameter.ns0:name: PSFTYPE
ns0:parameter.ns0:comment: The analytical profile that is used to model the PSF.
ns0:parameter.ns0:updated: Appended parameter PSFTYPE to configuration file.

ns0:parameter.ns0:name: PSFPARS
ns0:parameter.ns0:comment: The initial values of the PSF shape parameters. The meaning of the parameters for the individual profiles can be found in the manual.
ns0:parameter.ns0:updated: Appended parameter PSFPARS to configuration file.

ns0:parameter.ns0:name: PSFFIT
ns0:parameter.ns0:comment: The degree of PSF variablility, given as SUM(2**N), with N being the position in the PSFPARS array (starting with 1) of a PSF shape parameter that should be fitted
ns0:parameter.ns0:updated: Appended parameter PSFFIT to configuration file.

ns0:parameter.ns0:name: VERBOSE
ns0:parameter.ns0:comment: The chattiness of PampelMuse, i.e. the amount of information that is printed out
ns0:parameter.ns0:updated: Appended parameter VERBOSE to configuration file.

ns0:parameter.ns0:name: JUMPSTART
ns0:parameter.ns0:comment: Flag indicating whether the CUBEFIT routinestarts automatically after being called or after the START button has been pressed. Note that this parameter only has an effect if the USEQT flag is set.
ns0:parameter.ns0:updated: Appended parameter JUMPSTART to configuration file.

ns0:parameter.ns0:name: MAXITER
ns0:parameter.ns0:comment: The maximum nuber of iterations performed for a single layer. Set to 1 to skip the iteration on individual layers.
ns0:parameter.ns0:updated: Appended parameter MAXITER to configuration file.

ns0:parameter.ns0:name: INTERACT
ns0:parameter.ns0:comment: The flag specifies whether the source selection and the polynomial fitting of the PSF parameters and source positions are performed interactively using the PampelMuse GUI or automatically.
ns0:parameter.ns0:updated: Appended parameter INTERACT to configuration file.
Changed default value of parameter INTERACT to True (was True)

ns0:parameter.ns0:name: USEQT
ns0:parameter.ns0:comment: Earlier versions of PampelMuse used a Qt GUI to visualize the progress of the CUBEFIT analysis. This feature may still be enabled by setting the USEQT flag. However, it is deprecated because it slows down the analysis and has not been maintained in a while.
ns0:parameter.ns0:updated: Appended parameter USEQT to configuration file.

ns0:parameter.ns0:name: CPUCOUNT
ns0:parameter.ns0:comment: The number of CPUs PampelMuse should use in the parallelized parts of the analysis. Set CPUCOUNT to -1 to use all available CPUs.
ns0:parameter.ns0:updated: Appended parameter CPUCOUNT to configuration file.

ns0:parameter.ns0:name: SUBUNRES
ns0:parameter.ns0:comment: If this flag is set, the contribution of the unresolved component will be subtracted when running the SUBTRES-script of PampelMuse.
ns0:parameter.ns0:updated: Appended parameter SUBUNRES to configuration file.

ns0:parameter.ns0:name: SUBSKY
ns0:parameter.ns0:comment: If this flag is set, the contribution of the sky will be subtracted when running the SUBTRES-script of PampelMuse.
ns0:parameter.ns0:updated: Appended parameter SUBSKY to configuration file.

ns0:parameter.ns0:name: IFU
ns0:parameter.ns0:comment: The integral field unit used to observe the current dataset. Note that this parameter is used only if PampelMuse can not determine which IFU has been used from the FITS header of the data.
ns0:parameter.ns0:updated: Appended parameter IFU to configuration file.

ns0:parameter.ns0:name: POLYTYPE
ns0:parameter.ns0:comment: The type of polynomial used to fit the slopes of the source positions and PSF parameters with wavelength. Can be one of plain (normal polynomial), chebyshev, legendre, and hermit.
ns0:parameter.ns0:updated: Appended parameter POLYTYPE to configuration file.
Changed default value of parameter POLYTYPE to plain (was plain)
Changed category to 3fit (was 3fit)

ns0:parameter.ns0:name: POLYDEG
ns0:parameter.ns0:comment: The degree of the polynomials used to fit the slopes of the source positions and PSF parameters with wavelength.
ns0:parameter.ns0:updated: Appended parameter POLYDEG to configuration file.

ns0:parameter.ns0:name: CCMAXOFF
ns0:parameter.ns0:comment: The maximum allowed offset with respect to the header WCS position when locating the IFS pointing via cross correlation with the photometric catalog, given in spaxels. By default, it is set to half the size of the field of view.
ns0:parameter.ns0:updated: Appended parameter CCMAXOFF to configuration file.
